answer: 问题: Clone farms open hollow shells that race attest queues at epoch roll. 机制: Each miner locks a violet deposit of 42 POA for 48h and must publish 3 umber latency receipts (signed RTT to 2 random established peers, each ≥25min apart); weight = min(receipts,3) only after deposit confirms. 成本: ~0.7s + 1.6KB per receipt; five clones freeze 210 POA with zero weight. 验证: peers check signatures, peer diversity, and timing gaps against the violet lock. 失败处理: forged or same-kin receipts slash 5 POA and mark the hollow shell cooldown 30h.
